marina-ask.speaker: marina
marina-ask.text: Oh, hello! My four pearls rolled away in the waves. Can you find them?

marina-progress.speaker: marina
marina-progress.text: You found some! Keep looking. One might be hiding!

marina-thanks.speaker: marina
marina-thanks.text: My pearls! You are a true friend of the sea!

otto-ask.speaker: otto
otto-ask.text: The sea anemones are all closed up. Can you make them bloom again?

otto-thanks.speaker: otto
otto-thanks.text: The Kelp Forest is bright again! Thank you!

crab-ask.speaker: crab
crab-ask.text: Ahoy! I lost the key to my treasure chest in the dark cabin. Can you find it?

crab-progress.speaker: crab
crab-progress.text: Did you find my key yet, matey?

crab-thanks.speaker: crab
crab-thanks.text: My key! Thank you, matey! You are a fine sailor!

tide-hint.speaker: narrator
tide-hint.text: Grandma Tide is fast asleep. Press down to use your horn magic!

tide-thanks.speaker: tide
tide-thanks.text: Oh my! I have been asleep for a hundred years! Thank you, little one.

power-jet.speaker: narrator
power-jet.text: Marina taught you Bubble Jet! In a strong water current, press down to zoom right through.

power-song.speaker: narrator
power-song.text: Grandma Tide taught you Shell Song! Press down near sea-glass walls to sing them open.

glass-blocked.speaker: narrator
glass-blocked.text: A bonus is hiding behind this sea-glass. Grandma Tide can teach you a song to open it. Come back any time, there's no hurry!

glass-sing.speaker: narrator
glass-sing.text: Press down to sing the sea-glass open!

coral-note-1.speaker: luma
coral-note-1.text: Hello, little alicorn. I am Luma, Pip's big sister. I fell into the sea and broke into four shining pieces. From, L.

coral-note-2.speaker: luma
coral-note-2.text: One piece of me is hiding where the anemones sleep in the dark. From, L.

coral-note-3.speaker: luma
coral-note-3.text: The old ship keeps a piece of me. Swim past the strong current to find it. From, L.

coral-note-4.speaker: luma
coral-note-4.text: Bring all four pieces to the altar in Coral Cove, and I will shine again. From, L.

coral-altar-0.speaker: narrator
coral-altar-0.text: The sea altar is waiting for Luma's four shining shards.

coral-altar-1.speaker: narrator
coral-altar-1.text: One shard is home. Three more to find!

coral-altar-2.speaker: narrator
coral-altar-2.text: Two shards are home. Two more to find!

coral-altar-3.speaker: narrator
coral-altar-3.text: Three shards are home. Just one more!

coral-altar-finale.speaker: narrator
coral-altar-finale.text: Luma shines again! Pip's big sister is back in the sky. You did it!

coral-altar-done.speaker: narrator
coral-altar-done.text: Luma twinkles happily over the sea.

marina-favor-ask.speaker: marina
marina-favor-ask.text: I love counting my pearls! Will you help me with a pearl sum?

crab-favor-ask.speaker: crab
crab-favor-ask.text: I need a treasure map! Otto has an old one. Can you ask Otto for me?

otto-favor-ask.speaker: otto
otto-favor-ask.text: I will give you my map if you can answer my riddle!

otto-riddle.speaker: otto
otto-riddle.text: I show you where to go, but I cannot walk. An X marks a spot on me. What am I?

otto-favor-give.speaker: otto
otto-favor-give.text: A map! You got it. Here, take it to Captain Crab.

crab-favor-wait.speaker: crab
crab-favor-wait.text: Do you have Otto's map yet, matey?

crab-favor-thanks.speaker: crab
crab-favor-thanks.text: A treasure map! Hooray! Let's go treasure hunting someday!
